transaction.candidate_identity: candidate_id + plan_id + graph_revision + host_generation + pipeline_generation + processing_generation
transaction.commit_receipt: installed + observed_plan_id + observed_graph_revision + observed_pipeline_generation + native_runtime_identity + post-install exact readback
transaction.stale_commit_rejected: DSP_STALE_COMMIT when the requested revision advanced
transaction.abort_truth: native teardown failure raises DSP_ABORT_FAILED and keeps ownership; no silent continue
transaction.capability_fail_closed: runtime_failure => UNAVAILABLE + empty strategies; probe checks property writability and working-precision pad caps
transaction.readback_exactness: node-id set equality, duplicates/extra/missing rejected, per-node native factory multiset, unexpected resampler rejected
transaction.owner_safety: ONE serialized processing-transaction worker; the owner/Qt thread only assigns the intent revision and enqueues. NO lock is held across IPC. host-loss retirement takes only a short state lock and never waits on a blocked transaction.
transaction.supersession: newest intent wins: queued older work is dropped with a typed DSP_STALE_INTENT; an in-flight older candidate is fenced at commit with DSP_STALE_COMMIT. Superseded work is delivered, never silent.
transaction.abort_double_fault: invalid readback + failed child abort raises DSP_CANDIDATE_ABORT_FAILED with both causes and candidate_retained=true (native ownership never silently lost).
transaction.post_commit_containment: a valid receipt whose installed graph cannot be proven is contained: proven bypass is attempted, EFFECTIVE is retired to UNAVAILABLE, and the typed error carries containment_attempted/proven. A rejected receipt leaves the effective predecessor state untouched (PREPARING).
transaction.host_lost_fanout: the hosted port registry is keyed by WEAK IDENTITY (WeakSet); a closed/reopened port never inherits another object's listener.
